name: Logo Work Gloves LLC
old_description: Logo Work Gloves LLC provides custom logo printing on work gloves for businesses across the United States, branding cotton, leather, fleece, winter, dipped, mechanic, and driver gloves. Operating since 1992.
about:
Logo Work Gloves LLC, based in Monument, Colorado, was founded in 1992 as a family-owned business. The company began with a focus on providing custom logo printing on work gloves for businesses across the United States, building a reputation for quality hand protection that carries a customer’s brand.

The company specializes in private-label promotional gloves, offering custom printing on a range of styles including cotton, leather (cowhide and pigskin), fleece, winter insulated, dipped (nitrile foam and smooth), mechanic, and driver gloves. Using premium materials and precise printing methods, they ensure logos resist fading, peeling, or cracking. Operations are supported by a staff of 51–200 employees, and the company reports more than one million gloves sold since inception. An online ordering system provides free digital proofs before production.

Logo Work Gloves serves industries such as construction, corporate promotional programs, off-road driver training, trucking, and general industrial safety. Customers include companies outfitting crews with branded uniforms, organizations seeking trade-show giveaways, and firms like The Driving Company, which uses the gloves for off-road training safety and brand visibility. The gloves are also marketed for individual consumers needing personalized winter or work gloves.

The company differentiates itself through its “Handshake Guarantee,” promising to work with customers until they are satisfied. Founded on the slogan “They’ll know you like the back of their hand,” Logo Work Gloves emphasizes keeping the client’s logo front and center, combining durable hand protection with lasting brand exposure.
